Three explicit global lower witnesses, and an exact finite elimination for 4 paths x 3 weight regions x 8 x 8 facet pairs, generating 3840 critical polynomials and checking 2488 exact rational critical/mid weights. Any simultaneous facet violation is detected by endpoint or crossing tests; all feasibility-status changes lie on listed polynomial roots. The actual packaged standalone checker passed. Six reflection breakpoints establish exact \(1/40\) asymmetry. No floating-point or truncated finite grid is treated as a proof.

value.rationale: The first complete weighted profile for a canonical rational Lorentz octagon exposes a structural distinction: signed-permutation symmetry does not force reflection symmetry of an ORDERED Birkhoff-constrained weighted invariant. The result supplies sharp phase boundaries, an exact plateau and maximum \(1/40\) asymmetry, all on a natural minimal-dimensional non-Hilbert geometry. Full parameter classification and orientation-sensitive counterexample give a meaningful reusable benchmark, not a routine known-table computation. Narrow scope and source-access originality risks are disclosed.
